_note: Sofia's Backstage Pass inside the app (js/pass.js, wired in 1.47.0, Build 2 of the Oct 28 review; the file lived in tools/pass/backstage.json until then): the same guide as files/Sofia-Backstage-Pass.pdf (source tools/print/Sofia-Backstage-Pass.html), in 10 short parts. Each part has lines to read and one quick check (q, a = answers, ok = the right one's index, yay = what the right answer shows, hint = what a wrong one shows). Reading a part = getting its check right: settings.pass.read[partId] = date (schema 49), a star. Today shows the next part until all 10 are read, then the tip of the day; the Bunny asks for the next part once nothing has been read for 2 days, and says the day's tip once per phone per day. tips = the Bunny's regular reminders from the pass: when = the moments a tip fits (any, morning, evening, studio = a studio day before class, after = a studio day after class, home = a home practice day, rest = Mon/Tue no home practice, sat, sun), part = the part it comes from. Food is meat-free (Sofia is pescatarian). Keep the week in step with data/classes.json and home-days.json. Build 4, Part B (Oct 29): the one 🧠 Memorize door, the 🎬 Sunday sheet, ✓ Made it and the finish lines, How ready?, plan first on Play, the sticker on ⭐ Plan done, the 8-page Toolkit, the Saturday memory run. tests/pass-coverage.test.js checks that every README feature is named in Sofia's words here or allowed out with a reason (the allowlist lives in the test, not here), that the Toolkit's page count is the one both Passes name, and that the binder's six dividers are in both. 1.64.1 (Nov 5, Jenya: no more reprints): these words follow what the app asks since 1.60.0 (class days ask nothing at home, a home day asks one thing she picks, the games are open, counts only go up) and where things are since 1.61.0 (four tabs); the printed Pass keeps its Nov 2 words, so the two differ on the week, the memory run and what comes first, and the crew part says to go with the app. tests/pass1641.test.js.
title: My Backstage Pass

lines: You have three helpers this season. Each one has its own job, like a stage crew.

📱 Spotlight app = TODAY. Four tabs at the bottom: Today, Dances, Skills and Me. On Today, ▶ My solo and ▶ My trio open the practice player with your music. 🧠 Memorize, the 🎬 Sunday sheet, stars and games are in the app too.

📋 Practice Toolkit = HOW. Paper, 8 pages: the plan, your sticker tracker (Thu, Fri, Sun, My one fix, the ◀ THIS WEEK clip), the countdown and My rewards, My week, how to practice, your solo map, the trio and This week.
📕 Season Workbook = EVERYTHING ELSE. 16 pages, 6 in your binder: group dances, show day, packing lists, music and people, count sheets.
If two helpers say different things, your teachers win. After that the app wins, because it's the newest.
The paper pages were printed before the app got simpler, so some of them ask for more. When they don't match, go with the app.

check.q: Where do you look to see what to do TODAY?
check.hint: Which helper knows what day it is?

lines: All your paper lives in one binder with 6 tabs, in this order:
1 · Start here: your Backstage Pass
2 · My plan: the plan, your sticker tracker, the countdown + rewards, My week, This week
3 · Practice: how to practice, count sheets
4 · My dances: solo, trio, PITCH jazz, PITCH contemporary
5 · Aerial: your Aerial Mission
6 · Show time: mind tools, packing lists, music and people

check.q: Your packing list is behind which tab?
check.yay: Right! Show time has everything for show week 🎒
check.hint: You pack the week of a show…

lines: Home day (Thu, Fri, Sun): pick one thing, about 10 minutes. ▶ My solo on Today is a good one: your music plays, and one dance to the end counts.
Finished? When the app says ⭐ Plan done, put a sticker on Toolkit page 2.
Want more? On Today tap 📋 The whole session, then ▶ Start practice. Keep Toolkit page 4 open next to you for your fixes. It's there when you want it.
Want to watch it first? 📹 Videos on Today has Hannah's videos. On a video that plays inside the app, 🪞 Mirror flips it so you can follow it like a mirror.
A part of your solo keeps slipping? Dances, your solo, 🧠 Memorize. Chunks plays one piece at a time, Pause & Predict asks what comes next. One 8-count at a time.
A teacher gave you a correction (Saturday group rehearsal too)? Tell Mom and add it with ＋ Note. It becomes your fix right away.
Something feels off while your music plays? Tap 📝 Fix here in the practice player. It saves a note with that spot in the music.
Learning a trick? Tap Skills (the third tab at the bottom). In ⭐ I'm working on, tap ＋ Pick a skill and choose it. You pick the skills, and you can change them any time.
Each skill on your list has 📷 Add a photo. One every few weeks and your photos line up, so you can see how far you've come.
Want a tip on a skill? Tap 🎬 Coach me next to it and send a photo or a short video. The coach tells you one thing you did well and one thing to fix.

Sunday is film day: film your solo with Mom (that can be your one thing), then open the 🎬 Sunday sheet on Today. It walks you and Mom through it: watch the last run, say what went well, then ✓ It showed or Not yet for your one fix.
Butterflies before a show? Open the Show time tab, then smell the flower, blow out the candle.

check.q: A teacher gives you a correction. What now?
a: Wait and see if she says it again
Tell Mom and add it with ＋ Note
check.yay: Yes! Teachers win, and their notes go in right away ✏️
check.hint: Teachers win, and their notes go in right away.

parts.n: The big goal, in small steps
lines: The big goal: dance your solo at the Winter Showcase from memory. Your biggest, best dancing, eyes up, holding the ending to the very last note. And love doing it.
1 · Own it (to Nov 8): know every step by heart. Memory + knees, no new tricks yet.
2 · Clean it (Nov 9–29): feet, knees, arms, eyes. One fix at a time. Show in your head starts.
3 · Perform it (Nov 30–Jan 3): dance it like the real show. Your biggest, best dancing, costume on. Show your family at home.
4 · Rest up (Jan 4 to the show): fewer runs from Dec 28. Less work, more rest. Nothing new.
Your finish lines are on Today's season card and on Toolkit page 1. When you make one, tap ✓ Made it with Mom, then pick a reward on page 2b.
Tap How ready? on Today to see four bars for your solo. Pause & Predict fills Know, fixes that showed fill Clean, your eight tricks fill Tricks, full runs and Sunday films fill Perform.
Tiny steps win: one 8-count at a time, one fix at a time, one dance at a time. Every dance you finish adds to your count, and the count only goes up.

a: When it shows on two videos in a row
check.yay: That's it! Two videos in a row, then the next fix 🎬

lines: Mon · Ballet, Acro, Jazz Tech at the studio (4:30–7:30). No home practice: class is your dancing today.
Tue · Hip Hop, Ballroom (5:30–7:30). No home practice.
Wed · Contemporary (6:30–7:30). Solo rehearsal when one is booked. No home practice.
Thu · Home day: pick one thing, about 10 minutes.
Fri · Home day: pick one thing, about 10 minutes.
Sat · Co Tech + PITCH rehearsal (10:00–12:15). The big groups practice here. No home practice.
Sun · Home day: pick one thing. It's film day too: the 🎬 Sunday sheet is on Today. Plan your week on Toolkit page 6.
On a home day the whole session is one tap away: Today, then 📋 The whole session. It's there when you want it.
Studio closed Nov 25–29 and Dec 19–Jan 1: your class days are home days. Show day has no home practice: dance your best on stage!

check.q: Which days are home practice days?
check.yay: Yes! Thu, Fri and Sun at home 🏠
check.hint: Mon, Tue, Wed and Sat are class days. Class is enough on those.

lines: A happy dancer keeps four lights on. Each one gets some time every week.
💃 Dance: classes plus short home practices. That's enough. More isn't always better.
📚 School: read a little every day. Ask for help early if something feels hard.
🏠 Home: chores are teamwork. Pack your dance bag and put it by the door, help with dinner, tidy your dance spot.
🎈 Fun: friends, playing outside, drawing, family time, even doing nothing at all.
Feeling like it's too much? Always tired, grumpy about dance, a sore spot that won't go away, worries at bedtime? Tell Mom. A lighter day is part of the plan.

check.q: Dance has felt like too much lately. What do you do?
check.yay: Yes. Tell Mom. A lighter day is allowed 💛
check.hint: Who helps you change the plan?

parts.n: Ways to fit it all in + when to use screens
lines: Same time, same place makes it easy: on Thu, Fri and Sun, dance at about the same time.
Your one thing is short: about 10 minutes, and that's all for the day.
Best time on a home day: a small snack after school, dance about 45 minutes later, dinner after. Never right after a big meal: wait 1½–2 hours.
In the app: the countdown door, the dare and the games are open every day. They live on Play, under 🎉 Weekend games and ✨ Extras. Play is a button on Me.
When your music ends, that's one dance. You can stop there.
Plan on Sunday with Toolkit page 6. Pack your dance bag the night before.
Don't feel like it? Do the tiniest step: tap ▶ My solo and just listen to your music.
The app is a tool: open it, dance, close it.
Screens off 1 hour before bed. Phones and tablets sleep outside your room.

check.q: When are the countdown door and the games open?
check.yay: Yes! Every day. They're on Play 🎮
check.hint: Look for the words open every day.

lines: Dancing burns lots of energy. Food is your fuel.
Every morning: oatmeal with berries, eggs and toast, yogurt with granola, or a waffle with peanut butter.
1–2 hours before class: banana + peanut butter, apple + cheese, yogurt, crackers + hummus, or trail mix.
After class: chocolate milk, Greek yogurt, eggs, a tuna or salmon sandwich, a bean-and-cheese quesadilla, or edamame.
Every day: a rainbow of fruits and veggies, milk or yogurt for strong bones, beans, lentils, eggs and fish for energy.
Water bottle at every class. Sip before, during and after.
Never skip a meal. Dancers run on fuel. Growing bodies change and need lots of food.

check.q: What's a good snack 1–2 hours before class?
check.yay: Yum, yes! 🍌 Small and easy before class.

lines: Dancers your age need 9–12 hours of sleep every night.
While you sleep, your brain saves the steps you practiced, and your muscles repair and grow.
Same bedtime every night, weekends too. Wake up at 7:00 → lights out by 9:00.
Late studio nights (Mon, Tue): dinner, shower, bed.
Wind down: shower, PJs, a paper book, lights out.

check.q: How much sleep do dancers your age need?

parts.n: Take care of your dancer body
lines: Normal, keep going: muscles that burn while you work, tired legs the next day, a stretch you can feel.
Stop and tell Mom: sharp pain, pain in a knee, ankle, wrist or back, swelling, limping, or pain that wakes you up.
Warm up first, always. A stretch, never pain. No oversplits.
Acro on the mat or with a spotter. Kick-overs and aerials only in class.
Stop before you're too tired. Tired teaches your body the wrong way.
Knees over toes in every plié, lunge and landing.
Nervous? Smell the flower (in for 4), blow out the candle (out for 6). Three times.
Be kind to yourself. Mistakes are how dancers learn.

check.q: Sharp pain in your knee during practice. What do you do?
check.yay: Yes. Sharp pain is a STOP sign 🛑
check.hint: Is sharp pain the normal kind?
